goal: The user receives only shadow results: rejected engine actions, batched, with cause and would-be effect, and nothing else from routine operation.
acceptance: shadow rows from Dev, Ops and the VM engine are collected and sent to baseline as shadow/1 through ops/flow/flow.py
one batched digest per period or when a dependent chain is blocked; no per-row messages
each row states what was rejected, by which check, why, and what it would have done
routine successes do not reach the user (dashboard only)
